task.title: Reduce origin lookup cost for trees with many staged submodules
task.problem: Finding the innermost submodule scans the module list for each path, including superproject paths that match none.
task.proposal: Index staged modules by path and walk parent components from deepest to shallowest. Keep the no-module shortcut.
acceptance: Match current origin and .gitreview selection for nested modules, similarly named siblings, paths outside modules, and empty or missing modules. Preserve unstaged diagnostics.
Compare no-module, moderate and many-module fixtures; record lookup cost and full --origin --json search time before deciding. Check that the common no-module case does not regress.
evidence: 20k path lookups across 128 staged modules took 118 ms with a list vs 5 ms with parent-path lookup (lookup only). See https://github.com/rmorozov/bst-utilities/pull/17#pullrequestreview-6013606582 and docs/source-grep-performance.md.
